text.text: "Anybody wanna buy a pug? I accept all currencies; Water, meth, Chuck E Cheese tokens... I'll find you."
"Anyone ever find it weird how most of the weapons we find in gun stores are over a hundred years old?"
"Do NOT trust Perfection."
"The porcelain spire beckons for me... I must."
"I saw a fucking ring-tailed lemur running around earlier. Did the wildlife sanctuaries release all their animals when the world ended?"
"I had to eat a pug today. I feel wrong."
"I saw a black pug fighting off zombies today. Surprisingly strong creature."
"Speed Lordz rule!"
"I saw a guy with no face in the basement. No not that one, this one looked like a hobo"
"I miss my wife :("
"Every day it feels like another apocalypse hits. Zombies, entities, aliens..."
"We survive because the invaders hate each other more than us"
"I swear I saw something like these Perfection fuckers in an old card game..."
"An RV crashed through one of those portals. Killed a shoggoth as it did. Some guy came out and offered us a pug. Trust Paul, Paul seems alright.."
"God damn it, the boss is gonna be so mad. A catgirl stole my damned van, all because I had to piss..."
"Heard some stupid idiot go on about how 'humans are the real monsters'. Okay Sharon, but have you considered the flesh eating dead? How about the invading porcelain fuckwads?"
"Somebody pissed in my cranberry juice..."
"How are there anglerfish in fresh water?"
"God damn I saw a massive koi eat Jimothy."
"No zombie is safe from Oroville Johnny!"
"Man do I regret being so against Minuteman Munitions now."
"Are these notes just pieces ripped from survivor's diaries?"
"RED SUN DID IT!"
"AAron was here." Alongside the message is a fucked up drawing of a child.
"Nothing beats a pet in this new world. Cats, dogs, chickens, cows. Sometimes you need companionship that won't complain about how much better things were."
"I bought a box of MREs to prepare, but I got scammed, these are all Vegetarian Omelette. I'm going to kill myself."
"Why couldn't this have been a fun apocalypse? Like, one that just wiped out governments."
"The Catholic church is coming! We're saved!"
"Oh no, its the catholic church..."
"Sinners will be given no quarter. Kill them all, let God sort them out."
"I keep getting harassed by these people dressed like fascists. Why couldn't the zeds have taken these fuckers?"
"Bright side of the zombie apocalypse? No need to worry about being able to afford my collection. Downside? Now I have to find these things manually..."
"I miss internet pornography..."
"I found a box of novelty 9 mil... The end of the bullet ended in a penis head. Penetrated right through everything I shot. Good stuff."
"Brass case shotgun shells are better for heavier targets. 'Course, a bigger shell is even better."
"Oh, shit, I found an anti-tank rifle! Things are finally looking up!"
"Looking to shed your humanity to survive better? I know a good Runoff dealer. Find me at the house on the northeast quadrant of the intersection of 6th and G in concord. Ask for Uncle Stan."

"I saw a big-ass wolf woman, had to be 10 feet tall, strapped with more guns than i could count, and pushing a shopping cart full of rotted corpses. I kept my distance, I'm not stupid, but the answer is would."

"I fucked up guys. I fucked up real bad. I tried going hunting with my "fuck your shit" rounds. 93 octane with rubbing alcohol and styrofoam, loaded into 12 gauge shells... I thought it would burn the fur off the squirrels, not SET THE GODDAMN WOODS ON FIRE."
"Living in a basement has never been a better decision. Dumb zombies dont understand stairs."
